name: govee
title: Govee
description: Control Govee lights over LAN or the cloud, set colors and brightness, apply snapshots and music modes, and run scenarios.
author: j3lte

commands.name: govee-menu-bar
commands.title: Govee Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Govee
commands.description: Your lights, scenarios and snapshots in the macOS menu bar. Off until you enable it.

preferences.title: Device discovery timeout
preferences.name: deviceDiscoveryTimeout
preferences.description: Timeout in milliseconds for device discovery (default: 5000)

preferences.title: Devices Section
preferences.name: devicesPosition
preferences.description: Where the Devices section appears in the list, or Hidden to remove it. If two sections share a position, they keep the default order (Devices, Scenarios, Snapshots, Music Modes).

preferences.title: Scenarios Section
preferences.name: scenariosPosition
preferences.description: Where the Scenarios section appears in the list, or Hidden to remove it.

preferences.title: Snapshots Section
preferences.name: snapshotsPosition
preferences.description: Where the Snapshots section appears in the list, or Hidden to remove it.

preferences.title: Music Modes Section
preferences.name: musicPosition
preferences.description: Where the Music Modes section appears in the list, or Hidden to remove it.

preferences.title: Govee API Key (optional)
preferences.name: goveeApiKey
preferences.description: Lets you control lights without LAN Control (e.g. bulbs) and use snapshots, music modes and white temperature through the Govee cloud. Lights on LAN still use LAN. How to get a key (with screenshots): https://developer.govee.com/reference/apply-you-govee-api-key
